lines.t: I was running from the fire in my chest, but you pulled me from the darkness to your rest
Even when the night was tearing up my mind, your mercy found me every single time I fought, you fight
You're the truth that brings me back to life
And even when I break inside You stay and hold me through the night
I was lost in the smoke, couldn't breathe, couldn't stand
Every promise that I made turned to dust in my hands
I was wrestling with shadows that were strangling my hope
Trying to fix my own pain with a temporary road
But you broke through the lies I was living inside
Pulled the thorns from my pride, gave me reason to rise
Now I'm runnin' to the one who gave sight to the blind
Every scar on my heart, you redesigned
When the fear starts creepin' in
You remind me who I am
In the storm my strength is thin
But you lift me once again
I was runnin' from the fire in my chest
But you pulled me from the darkness to your rest
Even when the night was staring at my mind
Your mercy found me every single time I fall
You fight, you're the truth that brings me back to life
And even when I break inside
You're staying on me through the night
Oh, oh
Oh, oh
Oh, oh
